## annotation

```{r}
BRCA1_annotation <- fread("/reference/gene_models/GRCh38_gencode_v41/primary_files/gencode.v41.annotation_comprehensive.gtf") %>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(V9, "BRCA1|NBR2"), V3 == "exon")%>%
  mutate(gene_name= sub('.*gene_name \"([^;]*)\".*',"\\1", V9),
         transcript_id= sub('.*transcript_id \"([^;]*)\".*',"\\1", V9),) %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames = V1, start = V4, end = V5, strand = V7, type = V3, gene_name, transcript_id) %>%
  dplyr::filter(transcript_id %in% c("ENST00000357654.9", "ENST00000657841.1"))

transcript_annot <- fread("ref/MANE.GRCh38.v1.3.ensembl_genomic.gff.gz",skip ="chr1", fill = T) %>%
  filter(str_detect(V9, "MANE_Select"), V3 == "exon")%>%
 mutate(gene_name=  str_extract(V9, "(?<=gene_name=)[^;]+"),
         transcript_id= str_extract(V9, "(?<=transcript_id=)[^;]+")) %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames = V1, start = V4, end = V5, strand = V7, type = V3, gene_name, transcript_id)

annotation_edp <- fread("ref/EDPnew_20240409.bed") %>%
  mutate(chromStart = chromStart -500, chromEnd = chromEnd +500) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom = `#chrom`, chromStart, chromEnd, name)
```

### mRNA

#### pdx

```{r}
library(edgeR)
mrna_hom_me_list <- list("134011", "134062", "SFRC01585", "SFRC01334S1","WEHI_CS62", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30")

mRNA_batch1 <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/mRNA/Kondrashova_-_HRD_-_RNAseq_Feb_2025.genes.ExpectedCounts.csv") 


mRNA_batch2 <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/mRNA/Kondrashova_-_HRD_-_RNAseq_Feb_2026.genes.ExpectedCounts.csv") 

gene_list <- mRNA_batch1 %>%
  dplyr::select( -starts_with("134"), -starts_with("S"), -starts_with("O")) %>%
  mutate(Length = `Gene End (bp)` - `Gene Start (bp)`) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Ensembl Gene ID")
mRNA_cnts <- mRNA_batch1 %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_ID = `Ensembl Gene ID`, starts_with("134")|starts_with("SF")|starts_with("O")|starts_with("SO")) %>%
  left_join(mRNA_batch2 %>%
              dplyr::select(gene_ID = `Ensembl Gene ID`, starts_with("SF") ), by = "gene_ID")


mRNA_cnts <- mRNA_cnts %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "gene_ID")

sample_list <- data.frame(sample = colnames(mRNA_cnts) ) %>%
    mutate(batch = if_else(sample %in% colnames(mRNA_batch1), "batch1", "batch2")) %>%
  separate(sample, into = c("sample", "drop"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  dplyr::select(-drop) %>%
  mutate(sample = gsub("S1|S2", "",sample), 
         BRCA1 = if_else(sample %in% mrna_hom_me_list, "Hom", "Het"))
  

star_matrix <- DGEList(counts = mRNA_cnts, group = factor(sample_list$BRCA1),batch = factor(sample_list$batch), samples = sample_list, genes = gene_list)

boxplot(cpm(star_matrix, log =T), use.cols = T)     

keep <- filterByExpr(star_matrix)
design.mat <- model.matrix(~star_matrix$samples$group+star_matrix$samples$batch)
star_matrix <- star_matrix[keep,, keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
star_matrix <- calcNormFactors(star_matrix)
boxplot(cpm(star_matrix, log =T), use.cols = T)    

prior_count <- 2
lib_size <- star_matrix$samples$lib.size * star_matrix$samples$norm.factors
scaled_prior_count <- prior_count * lib_size / mean(lib_size)
adj_lib_size <- lib_size + 2 * scaled_prior_count

fpkm <- t((t(star_matrix$counts) + scaled_prior_count) / adj_lib_size) * 1e6 / star_matrix$genes$Length * 1e3
tpm <- t(t(fpkm) / colSums(fpkm)) * 1e6
log_tpm <- log2(tpm)

lib_size <- colSums(star_matrix$counts)

mRNA_mapping<- data.frame(sample = c( "134011_2058_T3","134048_7496_T2","134062_2233_T3" ,"134169_6606_T2", "SFRC01428S1_22235_T2", "SFRC01495S2_1537_T1.x","SFRC01495S2_1537_T1.y", "SFRC01585S1_2163_T3.x" , "SFRC01585S1_2163_T3.y" , "SFRC01334S1_107_T5", "SOLACE20126S1_25285_T2" ), alt_name = c("#11", "#48","#62" ,"#169", "#428", "#495_1","#495_2", "#585_1" ,"#585_2" , "#334",  "#951"),
                          meBRCA1 = c("Hom meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1", "Hom meBRCA1",   "Het meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1","Het meBRCA1", "Hom meBRCA1", "Hom meBRCA1", "Hom meBRCA1",  "Het meBRCA1"))


pdx_tpm <- data.frame(log_tpm, check.names = F) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID") %>%
  left_join(gene_list %>%
              dplyr::select(`Associated Gene Name`) %>%
              rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c("ENSG_ID", "Associated Gene Name"), names_to = "sample", values_to = "log_tpm")%>%
  left_join(mRNA_mapping)



pdx_sample_selection <- fread("mRNA/Kondrashova_-_HRD_-_RNAseq_Feb_2025_RNASeQC_metrics.tsv") %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.Label, `Expression Profiling Efficiency`, `Total Purity Filtered Reads Sequenced`) %>%
  mutate(batch = "batch1") %>%
  rbind(fread("mRNA/Kondrashova_-_HRD_-_RNAseq_Feb_2026_RNASeQCv1_metrics.tsv")%>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.Label = `Sample Label`, `Expression Profiling Efficiency`, `Total Purity Filtered Reads Sequenced`)%>% mutate(batch = "batch2") ) %>%
  group_by(Sample.Label) %>%
  filter(n()>1,`Total Purity Filtered Reads Sequenced` == max(`Total Purity Filtered Reads Sequenced`) ) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(Sample.Label = if_else(batch =="batch1", paste(Sample.Label, "x", sep = "."), paste(Sample.Label, "y", sep = ".")))

pdx_mrna <- pdx_tpm%>%
  filter( !str_detect(sample, "x|y") |sample %in%pdx_sample_selection$Sample.Label) %>%
  mutate(alt_name = gsub("_1|_2", "", alt_name),
    meBRCA1 = factor(meBRCA1, levels = c("Hom meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1", "Mut BRCA1", "Restored BRCA1")),
         type = "PDX")
```

#### UWB1

```{r}
mRNA_UWB1 <- fread("/mnt/lustre/working/genomeinfo/share/analysis/Kondrashova_-_HRD_-_RNAseq/RNAseq_Nov_2024/Kondrashova_-_HRD_-_RNAseq_Nov_2024.genes.ExpectedCounts.csv") 
gene_list <- mRNA_UWB1 %>%
  dplyr::select( -starts_with("PEO"), -starts_with("UWB")) %>%
  mutate(Length = `Gene End (bp)` - `Gene Start (bp)`) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Ensembl Gene ID")

  dplyr::select(gene_ID = `Ensembl Gene ID`, starts_with("UWB"), -Strand)

mRNA_cnts_UWB1 <- mRNA_cnts_UWB1 %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "gene_ID")

sample_list <- data.frame(sample = colnames(mRNA_cnts_UWB1) ) %>%
  mutate(alt_name = if_else(str_detect(sample, "BRCA1"), "UWB1+BRCA1", "UWB1"),
         BRCA1 = if_else(str_detect(sample, "BRCA1"), "HRP", "HRD"))

sample_list$total_counts <- colSums(mRNA_UWB1[,15:20])
  

star_matrix_UWB1 <- DGEList(counts = mRNA_cnts_UWB1, group = factor(sample_list$BRCA1), samples = sample_list, genes = gene_list)

boxplot(cpm(star_matrix_UWB1, log =T), use.cols = T)     

keep <- filterByExpr(star_matrix_UWB1)
design.mat <- model.matrix(~star_matrix_UWB1$samples$group)
star_matrix_UWB1 <- star_matrix_UWB1[keep,, keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
star_matrix_UWB1 <- calcNormFactors(star_matrix_UWB1)
boxplot(cpm(star_matrix_UWB1, log =T), use.cols = T)    

prior_count <- 2
lib_size <- star_matrix_UWB1$samples$lib.size * star_matrix_UWB1$samples$norm.factors
scaled_prior_count <- prior_count * lib_size / mean(lib_size)
adj_lib_size <- lib_size + 2 * scaled_prior_count

fpkm <- t((t(star_matrix_UWB1$counts) + scaled_prior_count) / adj_lib_size) * 1e6 / star_matrix_UWB1$genes$Length * 1e3
tpm <- t(t(fpkm) / colSums(fpkm)) * 1e6
log_tpm <- log2(tpm)

uwb1_tpm <- data.frame(log_tpm, check.names = F) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID") %>%
  left_join(gene_list %>%
              dplyr::select(`Associated Gene Name`) %>%
              rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c("ENSG_ID", "Associated Gene Name"), names_to = "sample", values_to = "log_tpm")  %>%
  mutate(alt_name = if_else(str_detect(sample, "BRCA1"), "UWB1+BRCA1", "UWB1"))
```

### ICGC mRNA & methylation

```{r}
library(edgeR)
mRNA <- Sys.glob(paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/HRDmethyl_public/data/raw/20220505_ICGC_OV_meth/mRNA/*gene*ounts*"))%>%
    map_dfr(~ as.data.frame(fread(.x)))

  dplyr::select(dnaSampleLabel = testSampleLabel, SampleType = testSampleType, testQpureCellularity, donorLabel = testDonorLabel, dnaSampleSubmittedWithID = testSampleSubmittedWithID, dnaSampleDescription = testSampleDescription)

icgc_mRNA_sample <- fread("/mnt/lustre/working/genomeinfo/share/analysis/AOCS_-_ICGC_ovarian_cancer_project/RNASeq_July2019Run_ross/AOCS_-_ICGC_ovarian_cancer_project_2019.StudyRnaSeqReport.csv") %>%
   dplyr::select(sampleLabel, SampleType, donorLabel, sampleSubmittedWithID, sampleDescription) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(dnaSampleSubmittedWithID = gsub("DNA biospcimen id ", "", str_extract(sampleDescription, "(?i)DNA biospcimen id[: ]+.*"))) %>%
  left_join(icgc_dna_sample)
  

gene_list <- mRNA %>%
  dplyr::select( -starts_with("ICGC"), -starts_with("EXTERN")) %>%
  mutate(Length = `Gene End (bp)` - `Gene Start (bp)`) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Ensembl Gene ID")

  dplyr::select(gene_ID = `Ensembl Gene ID`, starts_with("ICGC")|starts_with("EXTERN"), -Strand) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "gene_ID")

sample_list <- data.frame(sample = colnames(mRNA_cnts) ) %>%
  left_join(icgc_mRNA_sample %>%
              mutate(sample = paste(sampleLabel, sampleSubmittedWithID, sep = "_"))) %>%
  mutate(type = if_else(SampleType == "Normal control (other site)", "N", "T"))
  
sample_list$total_counts <- colSums(mRNA[,9:142])
star_matrix <- DGEList(counts = mRNA_cnts, group = factor(sample_list$type), samples = sample_list, genes = gene_list)

boxplot(cpm(star_matrix, log =T), use.cols = T)     

keep <- filterByExpr(star_matrix)
design.mat <- model.matrix(~star_matrix$samples$group)
star_matrix <- star_matrix[keep,, keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
star_matrix <- calcNormFactors(star_matrix)
boxplot(cpm(star_matrix, log =T), use.cols = T)    

prior_count <- 2
lib_size <- star_matrix$samples$lib.size * star_matrix$samples$norm.factors
scaled_prior_count <- prior_count * lib_size / mean(lib_size)
adj_lib_size <- lib_size + 2 * scaled_prior_count

fpkm <- t((t(star_matrix$counts) + scaled_prior_count) / adj_lib_size) * 1e6 / star_matrix$genes$Length * 1e3
tpm <- t(t(fpkm) / colSums(fpkm)) * 1e6
log_tpm <- log2(tpm)


ICGC_tpm <- data.frame(log_tpm, check.names = F) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID") %>%
  left_join(gene_list %>%
              dplyr::select(`Associated Gene Name`) %>%
              rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c("ENSG_ID", "Associated Gene Name"), names_to = "sample", values_to = "log_tpm")%>%
  right_join(sample_list %>%
              dplyr::select(-type, -sampleSubmittedWithID))




icgc_methylation <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/HRDmethyl_public/data/processed/methylation/ICGC_OV_beta_subset_promo.csv") %>%
  filter(PredefinedCpG =="BRCA1") %>%
  mutate(Donor = substr(Sample.ID, 1, 8)) 


icgc_methylationlist <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/HRDmethyl_public/data/processed/TCGA_ICGC_methylation_list.tsv") %>%
  filter(Project == "OV", Methylation == "BRCA1") %>%
  mutate(Sample.ID = gsub("_", "-", Sample.ID))

ICGC_tpm <- ICGC_tpm  %>%
  left_join(icgc_methylation %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample.ID, Sample_Group) %>%
              distinct() %>%
              mutate(dnaSampleLabel =gsub("_","-", substr(start = 10,stop =  31, Sample.ID) )) %>%
              dplyr::select(dnaSampleLabel, Sample_Group)) %>%
  mutate(Sample_Group = if_else(is.na(Sample_Group), SampleType, Sample_Group),
         Sample_Group = gsub("Tumour", "tumour", Sample_Group),
         Sample_Group = if_else(Sample_Group == "tumour local recurrence", "Relapse", Sample_Group)) 


 ICGC_tpm%>%
   filter(`Associated Gene Name` == "EZH1") %>%
   ggplot(aes(x = SampleType, y = log_tpm))+
   geom_boxplot()
```

```{r}
  map_dfr(~fread(.x) %>%

  mutate(total_cn = round(total_cn), B_cn = if_else(is.na(B_cn), 0, round(B_cn)),

                                      TRUE ~ "Refractory/Resistance"),

                                      TRUE ~ "NA"))  %>% dplyr::rename(Model =alt_name)
```

```{r}
BRCA1_meth <- Sys.glob("Me_all/*extract_5mc_brca1.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x) %>%
            mutate(Sample = gsub("_extract_5mc_brca1.tsv", "", basename(.x))))%>%
  mutate(Meth = if_else(mod_qual >0.6, "Me", "Un"),
         meBRCA1 = case_when(Sample %in% hom_me_list ~"Hom meBRCA1",
                         Sample %in% het_me_list ~"Het meBRCA1",
                         Sample %in% c("UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1") ~"No meBRCA1"),
         meBRCA1 = factor(meBRCA1, levels = c("Hom meBRCA1",  "Het meBRCA1", "No meBRCA1"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter( base_qual >=20) %>%
    dplyr::filter(ref_position <=43125457+3000, ref_position >= 43125336-3000, !inferred, mod_code == "m")  %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample=sample, alt_name))

BRCA1_meth <- BRCA1_meth %>%
  mutate(ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position -1, ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n()>2) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(Sample, read_id) %>%
  # filter(sum(ref_position  <= 43125457 & ref_position >= 43125336) >3 ) %>%
  mutate(perc_meth = sum(Meth == "Me" & ref_position >= 43124000 & ref_position <= 43126000) /sum(ref_position >= 43124000 & ref_position <= 43126000)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(alt_name, ref_position, read_id, meBRCA1, Meth, perc_meth)

write.csv(x = BRCA1_meth, file = "output/tables_plotting/Fig1_BRCA1_meth.csv",row.names = F, quote = F)

read_order = BRCA1_meth %>%
  dplyr::select(read_id, perc_meth) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(perc_meth)

plot_list <- BRCA1_meth %>%
  # filter(ref_position <= 43126118, ref_position >=  43125532) %>%
  mutate(read_id = factor(read_id, levels = read_order$read_id)) %>%
  group_by(meBRCA1, alt_name) %>%
  group_map(~ 
  ggplot(.x, aes(x =ref_position, y = read_id, color = Meth))+
  
  geom_point()+
  facet_wrap(~alt_name, nrow = 8, dir = "v", scales = "free_y")+
  theme_bw()+
    scale_colour_manual(values = methylation_palette, "5mC")+
   
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(43124988, 43125457))+
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(colour=sample_palette[unique(.x$meBRCA1)], face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()), .keep = T)

for (i in seq(length(plot_list))){
  ggsave(plot = plot_list[[i]]+theme(legend.position = "none"), filename = paste0("plots/read_level_brca1_prom_",i,".pdf"), height = 3, width = 4)
}
```

```{r}
         feature = str_match(V9, 'gene_type "([^"]+)";')[,2],
         gene =  str_match(V9, 'gene_id "([^"]+)";')[,2],
         exon=  str_match(V9, 'exon_id "([^"]+)";')[,2],
         exon_num = str_match(V9, 'exon_number ([^"]+);')[,2],

         symbol =  str_match(V9, 'gene_name "([^"]+)";')[,2],

         donorLabel =gsub("^SFCR01|SFRC01", "PDX #", donorLabel)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(donorLabel) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(track = list(AlignmentsTrack(alignedReadGroupSet, name = donorLabel))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(donorLabel = factor(donorLabel, levels = c("PDX #585","PDX #334","PDX #495" )))%>%
  arrange(donorLabel)
```

```{r}
changed_cpg <- readRDS("intermediate/non_fisher_changed_cpg.RDS")

changed_cpg_clean <- changed_cpg %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd, name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(transcript_annot, by = join_by(chrom ==seqnames, chromEnd >= start, chromStart<=end)) %>%
  mutate(name = if_else(nchar(name) ==11, gene_name, name)) %>%
  filter(name == gene_name) %>%
  group_by(chrom, name) %>%
  mutate(new_chromStart = min(chromStart), new_chromEnd = chromEnd) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom,chromStart, chromEnd, name, new_chromStart, new_chromEnd) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(changed_cpg) %>%
  dplyr::select(-chromStart, -chromEnd) %>%
  dplyr::rename(chromStart=new_chromStart, chromEnd = new_chromEnd)%>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(alt_name)>5) %>%
  mutate(HR = if_else(HR == "HRP", "Het meBRCA1", "Hom meBRCA1"),
         HR =  factor(HR, levels = c("Hom meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1")))

bnc1 <- changed_cpg_clean %>%
  filter(name == "BNC1", start >=	83284653, end <= 83285250) %>%
  group_by(Sample, alt_name, HR, name) %>%
  summarise(median_mod = median(fraction_mod)) %>%
  left_join(pdx_mrna %>%
              filter(alt_name != "#585") %>%
              mutate(alt_name = paste0("PDX ", alt_name)) %>%
              dplyr::select(alt_name, log_tpm, name = `Associated Gene Name`)%>%
  drop_na() %>%
  dplyr::select( log_tpm,  alt_name, name))
```

```{r}
  group_by(SampleID)%>%

              geom_rect(aes(xmin = 43125192 , xmax = 43125532, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), fill = alpha("#d9d9d9", alpha = 0.6), color = "#d9d9d9", alpha = 0.2)+

  theme_bw()+
```

```{r}
                                      type = "DEL")

overlapped_DEL_pileup_filt <- isogenic_overlap_svs(DEL_reads_h453, DEL_reads_a630, type = "DEL")


overlapped_DEL_reads <- DEL_reads_h453 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, SV_start, SV_end_453 = SV_end, ID_h453 =ID, REF, ALT, SV_type, SV_len_h453 =SV_len ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  full_join(DEL_reads_a630 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, SV_start, SV_end_630 = SV_end, ID_a630 =ID, REF, ALT, SV_type, SV_len_a630 = SV_len )%>%

  mutate(commonID = case_when(!is.na(ID_h453) &!is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_common"), 
                                !is.na(ID_h453) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_h453"),
                                !is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_a630, "_a630")),
         commonend = pmax(SV_end_453 ,SV_end_630, na.rm = T))

                     left_join(overlapped_DEL_reads %>%
                                 filter(!is.na(ID_h453)) %>%

                           dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
                           dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
        dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end = commonend, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod) %>%
          mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP H4-53"),
      DEL_reads_a630 %>%
        inner_join(overlapped_DEL_reads %>%
                      filter(!is.na(ID_a630))  %>%
                                       dplyr::select(ID = ID_a630, commonID, commonend)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
                           dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
        dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end = commonend, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod)%>%

  dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end, ref_position, read_id, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rbind(DEL_reads_uwb1_brca1 %>%
          mutate(Sample = if_else(read_type == "parent", "UWB1", "UWB1 BRCA1"),
                 ID = paste0(ID, "_U")) %>%
          dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, read_id, SV_end, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample)) %>%
  mutate(ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position -1, ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(ID, SV_start, SV_end, ref_position, chrom,  read_type) %>%
  filter(n()>3) %>%
  summarise(Meth = sum(mod == "Me"), read_cnts = n(),
            Unmeth = read_cnts - Meth,
            meth_perc = Meth/read_cnts) %>%
  ungroup() 

plot_DEL <- merged_DEL %>%
  filter(read_type == "parent", (meth_perc >=0.8| meth_perc <= 0.2) ) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, p_meth_perc= meth_perc) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_DEL%>%
              filter(read_type == "ref")) %>%
  filter(abs(meth_perc - p_meth_perc) <=0.2) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_DEL %>%
              filter(read_type != "parent")) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position -SV_start,
                               ref_position >= SV_end ~ ref_position -SV_end,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  mutate( SV_len = SV_end - SV_start)%>%
  distinct()%>%
  group_by(SV_len, ID, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_type)==2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  arrange(SV_len, ID, ref_position, read_type)


CpG_DEL_fisher <- plot_DEL  %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, ref_position,chrom, read_type, Meth, Unmeth, SV_len) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = c(Meth, Unmeth),names_from = read_type)%>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(ID, ref_position, SV_len) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p.value =fisher.test(x = matrix(c(Meth_alt, Meth_ref, Unmeth_alt, Unmeth_ref),byrow = T, nrow = 2))$p.value ) %>%
  mutate(diff = Meth_alt/(Meth_alt+Unmeth_alt) -  Meth_ref/(Meth_ref+Unmeth_ref)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(fisher.adj = p.adjust(p.value,method = "BH"),
         sig = (fisher.adj <= 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.8 )) %>%
  ungroup()  


plot_DEL_density <- plot_DEL%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Meth, Unmeth, read_cnts)) %>%

  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position -SV_start,
                               ref_position >= SV_end ~ ref_position -SV_end,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  mutate(diff = alt- ref) %>%
  distinct()

plot_DEL_density%>%
```

```{r}
library(Gviz)
library(GenomicRanges)

# Define chromosome
genome <- "hg38"
chr <- "chr17"


cyto <- fread("ref/cytoBand.txt.gz")
colnames(cyto) <- c("chrom", "chromStart", "chromEnd", "name", "gieStain")
# Ideogram track

track_list <- list()
for (s in c( "WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8", "UWB1", "PDX #11",  "PDX #62", "PDX #334", "PDX #585", "PDX #169","PDX #48", "PDX #428", "PDX #495",  "PDX #865", "PDX #951")) {

  # Subset data
  l2r_sub <- L2R %>% filter(alt_name == s)
  af_sub  <- hetSNP %>% filter(alt_name == s, V1 == "chr17")

  # L2R GRanges
  l2r_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = chr,
    ranges = IRanges(start = l2r_sub$start, end = l2r_sub$end),
    score = l2r_sub$log2r_copynumber
  )

  # AF GRanges (combine V11 + V12 if needed)
  af_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = af_sub$V1,
    ranges = IRanges(start = af_sub$V2, width = 1),
    score = af_sub$V11   # or average(V11, V12)
  )

  # Tracks
  l2rTrack <- DataTrack(
    range = l2r_gr,
    type = "p",
    name = paste0(s, " L2R"),
    col= scales::alpha("black", 0.5),
    ylim = c(-4, 4),
    cex= 0.3
  )

  afTrack <- DataTrack(
    range = af_gr,
    type = "p",
    col = scales::alpha("#185FA5", 0.5),
    name = paste0(s, " AF"),
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    cex = 0.3
  )

  track_list <- c(track_list, list(afTrack, l2rTrack))
}


ideoTrack <- IdeogramTrack(

)
```

```{r}
isl_annot <- fread("ref/cpg_islands_ucsc.bed") %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd) 

pmd_files <- list.files("output/MMSeekR", pattern="*_MMSeekR_models.multiModel.PMDs.bed", full.names=TRUE)

pmd_common <- fread("output/MMSeekR/common_pmd_g0.7.bed") 
pmd_common_gr <-  GRanges(seqnames = pmd_common$V1, ranges = IRanges(pmd_common$V2, pmd_common$V3))

# Optional: name each element by sample name
sample_names <- gsub("_MMSeekR_models.multiModel.PMDs.bed", "", basename(pmd_files))

# Import as GRanges
pmd_list <- lapply(pmd_files, function(f) {
  df <- fread(f, header=FALSE)
  GRanges(seqnames = df$V1, ranges = IRanges(df$V2, df$V3))
})
names(pmd_list) <- sample_names


seqlengths <- c(
  chr1=248956422, chr2=242193529, chr3=198295559,
  chr4=190214555, chr5=181538259, chr6=170805979,
  chr7=159345973, chr8=145138636, chr9=138394717,
  chr10=133797422, chr11=135086622, chr12=133275309,
  chr13=114364328, chr14=107043718, chr15=101991189,
  chr16=90338345, chr17=83257441, chr18=80373285,
  chr19=58617616, chr20=64444167, chr21=46709983,
  chr22=50818468, chrX=156040895
)

bins <- tileGenome(
  seqlengths = seqlengths,
  tilewidth = 50000,
  cut.last.tile.in.chrom = TRUE
)
mcols(bins)$bin_id <- seq_along(bins)


island_gr <-GRanges(seqnames = isl_annot$chrom,
                     ranges = IRanges(start=isl_annot$chromStart, end=isl_annot$chromEnd))
island_bins <- bins[countOverlaps(bins, island_gr) > 0]
pmd_ovcar8_bins <- bins[countOverlaps(bins, pmd_list[["OVCAR8"]]) > 0]

pmd_common_binds <- bins[countOverlaps(bins, pmd_common_gr) > 0]

sample_info <- tibble(
  Sample = c("OVCAR8", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "OVCAR8_LP_H4_53","UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1", "WEHI_CS62", "134011_1910_T4", "134062_9174_T4" ,"SFRC01428S1_22235_T2","134048_7794_T2", "SFRC01495S2_1537_T1", "SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2", "134169_6606_T2" , "SFRC01865S1_T1_2422", "SFRC01585S1_2163_T3", "SFRC01334S1_107_T5"),
  condition = c("HRP", "HRD", "HRD","HRD", "?","?", "HRD", "HRD", "HRP", "HRP", "HRP", "HRP","HRP", "HRP", "?", "?"),
 type = c("cellline","cellline","cellline","cellline","cellline","cellline","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx"  ))

HRD_HRP_meth <- rbind(cell_line_5mc %>%
  filter(Nvalid_cov >= 5,Nvalid_cov <= 100, chrom %in% paste0("chr", c(seq(1,22), "X"))) ,
  pdx_5mc%>%
  filter(Nvalid_cov >= 5,Nvalid_cov <= 100, chrom %in% paste0("chr", c(seq(1,22), "X"))))

cpg_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = HRD_HRP_meth$chrom,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = HRD_HRP_meth$start, end = HRD_HRP_meth$end),
  coverage = HRD_HRP_meth$Nvalid_cov,
  meth     = HRD_HRP_meth$fraction_mod,
  Sample   = HRD_HRP_meth$Sample
)

hits <- findOverlaps(bins, cpg_gr)

bin_meth <- tibble(
  bin_id = queryHits(hits),
  Sample = mcols(cpg_gr)$Sample[subjectHits(hits)],
  meth   = mcols(cpg_gr)$meth[subjectHits(hits)],
  coverage = mcols(cpg_gr)$coverage[subjectHits(hits)]
) %>%
  group_by(bin_id, Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_meth = sum(meth * coverage)/sum(coverage),
    n_cpg = n(),
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_cpg >= 10) %>%
  left_join(sample_info, by="Sample")


bin_meth_pdx <- bin_meth %>% filter(type=="pdx")

bin_meth_pdx$feature <- case_when(
  bin_meth_pdx$bin_id %in% mcols(island_bins)$bin_id ~ "Island",
  bin_meth_pdx$bin_id %in% mcols(pmd_common_binds)$bin_id ~ "PMD",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

library(ggridges)
bin_meth_pdx <- bin_meth_pdx %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample= sample, alt_name)) %>%
  mutate(feature= factor(feature, levels = c("Island", "PMD", "Other")),
         alt_name = factor(alt_name, levels =c( "PDX #951",  "PDX #865","PDX #495", "PDX #428", "PDX #48", "PDX #169", "PDX #585", "PDX #334","PDX #62", "PDX #11")),
         condition = case_when(alt_name %in% c("PDX #334", "PDX #585")~ "hom meBRCA1 (BRCA1 expressing)",
                              alt_name %in% c("PDX #11", "PDX #62")~ "hom meBRCA1 (BRCA1 silenced)",
                                TRUE ~"het meBRCA1"),
         condition = factor(condition, levels = c( "hom meBRCA1 (BRCA1 silenced)", "hom meBRCA1 (BRCA1 expressing)", "het meBRCA1")))

bin_meth_pdx%>%
ggplot(aes(x=mean_meth, y=alt_name, fill=condition)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha=0.6, scale=1) +
  facet_wrap(~feature, scales="free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=list("het meBRCA1" = "#481D24", "hom meBRCA1 (BRCA1 expressing)" = "grey" , "hom meBRCA1 (BRCA1 silenced)" = "#368F8B"))+
  labs(x="5mC (%)", y="Sample") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14)+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("plots/globalmethylation_pdx_5mc.pdf", height = 7, width = 9)



write.csv(bin_meth_pdx %>%
            dplyr::select(-Sample, -bin_id) , file = "output/tables_plotting/SuppFig7_global_isl_pmd_other.csv",row.names = F, quote = F)
```

```{r}
window_filter <- hanning(13)/sum(hanning(13))


BRCA1_5mC <- rbind(cell_line_5mc %>%
  dplyr::filter(chrom == "chr17", start >= 43125192-10000, end <= 43125532+10000),
  pdx_5mc %>%
  dplyr::filter(chrom == "chr17",  start >= 43125192-10000, end <= 43125532+10000))  %>%
  dplyr::filter(! Sample %in% c("UWB1_BRCA1", "OVCAR8_LP_H4_53", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "WEHI_CS62")) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  arrange(start)  %>%
  mutate(smoothed = stats::filter(fraction_mod/100,window_filter,sides = 2,method = "convolution"))


BRCA1_ext <- BRCA1_5mC %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample = sample, alt_name)) %>%
  mutate(meBRCA1 = if_else(Sample %in% hom_me_list, "Hom meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1"),
         meBRCA1 = if_else(Sample == "UWB1", "Mut BRCA1",meBRCA1),
         meBRCA1 = factor(meBRCA1, levels = c("Hom meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1", "Mut BRCA1"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start, group = Sample,  y = smoothed))+
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, aes(color = meBRCA1), alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_point(size = 0.4, aes(color = meBRCA1), alpha = 0.2)+
  scale_color_manual(values = sample_palette)+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 43125192 , xmax = 43125532,  ymin = -0.03, ymax = -0.02),  fill= "black", color = "black" , linewidth = 0.2)+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 43126118, xmax = 43126443, ymin = -0.03, ymax = -0.02),  fill= "black", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)+
  geom_text(aes(x = (43126118 + 43126443)/2 , y = -0.06, label = "CpG Island"))+
   geom_text(aes(x = (43125192 + 43125532)/2 , y = -0.06, label = "BRCA1 Promoter"))+
  theme_bw()+
  coord_cartesian(xlim =  c(43125192-10000, 43125532+10000) )+

  xlab("Chromosomal Position (hg38)")
```

```{r}
                  "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/landing_pad_mapping/clair3/OVCAR8_LP_H4_53_merged_SV_modkit_extract.tsv",

indel_del_uwb1_brca1 <- match_clair3_meth("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/landing_pad_mapping/clair3/del_uwb1_brca1_seq_df.RDS",
                  "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/landing_pad_mapping/clair3/UWB1_BRCA1_merged_SV_modkit_extract.tsv",

overlapped_indel_DEL_pileup_filt<- isogenic_overlap_svs(indel_del_h453 %>%
                                  dplyr::rename(SV_start = start, SV_end = end,  SV_len = indel_size, SV_type = type),
                     indel_del_a630 %>%
                                  dplyr::rename(SV_start = start, SV_end = end,  SV_len = indel_size, SV_type = type), "DEL")

overlapped_indel_del_reads <- indel_del_h453 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end, ID_h453 =ID, REF, ALT, type, indel_size ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  full_join(indel_del_a630 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end, ID_a630 =ID, REF, ALT, type, indel_size)%>%
    distinct())%>%
  mutate(commonID = case_when(!is.na(ID_h453) &!is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_common"), 
                                !is.na(ID_h453) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_h453"),
                                !is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_a630, "_a630")))

merged_indel_del <-rbind(indel_del_h453 %>%
                                 left_join(overlapped_indel_del_reads %>%
                                       filter(!is.na(ID_h453)) %>%
                                       dplyr::select(ID = ID_h453, commonID)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
                           dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
                           dplyr::select(ID, start, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod, indel_size, end) %>%
                           mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP H4-53"),
                   indel_del_a630 %>%
                           right_join(overlapped_indel_del_reads %>%
                                        filter(!is.na(ID_a630)) %>%
                                        dplyr::select(ID = ID_a630, commonID)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID)%>%
                     dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
                           dplyr::select(ID, start, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod, indel_size, end)%>%
                           mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP A6-30"))%>%
  dplyr::select(ID, start, end, ref_position, indel_size, read_id, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rbind(indel_del_uwb1_brca1 %>%
          mutate(Sample = if_else(read_type == "parent", "UWB1", "UWB1 BRCA1"),
                 ID = paste0(ID, "_U")) %>%
          dplyr::select(ID, start, end, ref_position, indel_size, read_id, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample)) %>%
  mutate(ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position -1, ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(ID, start, end, ref_position, chrom,  read_type, indel_size) %>%
  filter(n()>3) %>%
  summarise(Meth = sum(mod == "Me"), read_cnts = n(),
            Unmeth = read_cnts - Meth,
            meth_perc = Meth/read_cnts) %>%
  ungroup() 

plot_indel_del <- merged_indel_del  %>%
  filter(read_type == "parent", (meth_perc >=0.8| meth_perc <= 0.2) ) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, p_meth_perc= meth_perc, indel_size) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_indel_del%>%
              filter(read_type == "ref")) %>%
  filter(abs(meth_perc - p_meth_perc) <=0.2) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, ID, indel_size) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_indel_del %>%
              filter(read_type != "parent")) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= start ~ ref_position -start,
                               ref_position >= end ~ ref_position -end,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  distinct()%>%
  group_by(indel_size, ID, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_type)==2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  arrange(indel_size, ID, ref_position, read_type)


CpG_indel_del_fisher <- plot_indel_del  %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, ref_position,chrom, read_type, Meth, Unmeth, indel_size) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = c(Meth, Unmeth),names_from = read_type)%>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(ID, ref_position, indel_size) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p.value =fisher.test(x = matrix(c(Meth_alt, Meth_ref, Unmeth_alt, Unmeth_ref),byrow = T, nrow = 2))$p.value ) %>%
  mutate(diff = Meth_alt/(Meth_alt+Unmeth_alt) -  Meth_ref/(Meth_ref+Unmeth_ref)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(fisher.adj = p.adjust(p.value,method = "BH"),
         sig = (fisher.adj <= 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.8 )) %>%
  ungroup()  


plot_indel_del_density <- plot_indel_del%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Meth, Unmeth, read_cnts)) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = meth_perc, names_from = read_type) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= start ~ ref_position -start,
                               ref_position >= end ~ ref_position -end,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  mutate(diff = alt- ref) %>%
  distinct() 

plot_indel_del_density$density <-get_density(plot_indel_del_density$relat_pos, plot_indel_del_density$diff, n =80)

plot_indel_del_density%>%
  left_join(CpG_indel_del_fisher) %>%
  mutate(sig = factor(sig, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = relat_pos, y = diff, color = density))+
  geom_point(alpha= 0.8,aes(shape = sig))+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_color_viridis_c( name = "density")+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("FALSE"= 4, "TRUE" = 19),  "Sig change")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, "ALT - REF (%5mC)")+
  xlab("Relative distance to breakpoint (bp)")+
  ggtitle("DEL (INDEL)")+
  coord_cartesian(xlim= c(-5000, 5000))

ggsave("plots/indel_del_change.jpeg", width = 8, height = 4)

    dplyr::select(chrom, ref_position, relat_pos, diff, density, fisher.adj),file = "output/tables_plotting/SuppFig16_indel_density.csv",row.names = F, quote = F)
```

## Panel B

```{r}
del_change_counts <- rbind(CpG_indel_del_fisher %>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = indel_size) %>%
        mutate(type = "INDEL"),
      CpG_DEL_fisher%>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = SV_len) %>%
        mutate(type = "SV")) %>%
  mutate(Group = "Deletion",
         Sample =case_when(str_detect(ID, "_U$") ~"UWB1 BRCA1",
                           str_detect(ID, "_a630$") ~"OVCAR8 LP A6-30",
                           str_detect(ID, "_h453$") ~"OVCAR8 LP H4-53",
                           str_detect(ID, "_common$") ~"OVCAR8 common"),
         Sample = factor(Sample),
         starting =case_when(Meth_ref/ (Meth_ref +Unmeth_ref) >= 0.8 ~ "Ref Methylated",
                             Meth_ref/ (Meth_ref +Unmeth_ref) <= 0.2 ~ "Ref Unmethylated",
                             TRUE ~NA),
         starting = factor(starting, levels = c("Ref Methylated", "Ref Unmethylated")))  %>%
  filter(!is.na(starting)) %>%
  group_by(ID, alt_len, Group, type, Sample, starting) %>%
  summarise(changed = case_when( max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) & min(diff) <= -0.8  ~ "Bi-Directional",
                                   max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                   min(diff) <= -0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Decrease",
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(type, Sample, changed, starting) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(changed = factor(changed, levels = c("Bi-Directional", "Increase", "Decrease", 
                                              "No Change"))) 

del_change_counts%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = type, fill = changed, y = count))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black")+
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("N= ", count)),
             position=  position_fill(vjust = 0.5))+
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Sample), rows = vars(starting))+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Deletion Type")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sig_change_palette, "CpG changed (N>=1)")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, "Event with methylation change")+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA))


ggsave("plots/breakdown_Deletion_type_dir.pdf", width = 10, height =4)

write.csv(del_change_counts,file = "output/tables_plotting/SuppFig16_del_change_counts.csv",row.names = F, quote = F)
```

```{r}
del_len <- rbind(CpG_indel_del_fisher %>%

          mutate(type = "INDEL"),
      CpG_DEL_fisher%>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = SV_len) %>%

  rbind(rbind(CpG_indel_ins_fisher %>%

          mutate(type = "INDEL"),
        CpG_INS_fisher%>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = SV_len) %>%

          mutate(Group = "Insertion")) %>%
  rbind(CpG_DUP_fisher%>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = SV_len)%>%
          mutate(type = "SV", Group = "Duplication")) %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group),
         Sample =case_when(str_detect(ID, "_U$") ~"UWB1 BRCA1",
                           str_detect(ID, "_a630$") ~"OVCAR8 LP A6-30",
                           str_detect(ID, "_h453$") ~"OVCAR8 LP H4-53",
                           str_detect(ID, "_common$") ~"OVCAR8 common"),
                           Sample = factor(Sample),
         starting =if_else(Meth_ref/ (Meth_ref +Unmeth_ref) >= 0.8, "Ref Methylated", "Ref Unmethylated" ),
         starting = factor(starting, levels = c("Ref Methylated", "Ref Unmethylated")))  %>%
  group_by(ID, alt_len, Group, type, Sample, starting) %>%
  summarise(changed = case_when( max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) & min(diff) <= -0.8  ~ "Bi-Directional",
                                   max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                   min(diff) <= -0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Decrease" ,
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change")) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(changed = factor(changed, levels = c("Bi-Directional", "Increase", "Decrease", "No Change")))

##deletion
manual_stat <- compare_means(data = del_len%>%
                               filter(Group == "Deletion")  %>%
                               group_by(changed, type, starting) %>%
                               filter(n()>2) , formula = alt_len ~changed, group.by = c("type" ,"starting"),
                             ref.group = "No Change", method = "wilcox.test") %>%
  mutate(p.signif = if_else(p <=0.05, as.character(p.format), "ns")) %>%
  group_by(type, starting) %>%
  mutate(y.position = if_else(type == "SV", 6, 48+ 5* (row_number()-1))) %>%
  ungroup()

  filter(Group == "Deletion", type == "SV") %>%

  geom_violin(data = .%>%
                group_by(Group, Sample,  changed) %>%
                filter(n_distinct(ID)>2),
              fill= NA)+
  scale_color_manual(values = sig_change_palette, "Direction of Change")+

  facet_wrap(~starting, ncol = 4,scales = "free_x")+

  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30 , vjust = 0.5))
```

```{r}
  full_join(INS_reads_a630 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, SV_start, SV_end_630 = SV_end, ID_a630 =ID, REF, SV_type, SV_len_a630 = SV_len )%>%
    distinct())%>%
  mutate(commonID = case_when(!is.na(ID_h453) &!is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_common"), 
                                !is.na(ID_h453) ~ paste0(ID_h453, "_h453"),
                                !is.na(ID_a630) ~ paste0(ID_a630, "_a630")),
         commonend = pmax(SV_end_453 ,SV_end_630, na.rm = T),
         commonSV_len = pmax(SV_len_h453 ,SV_len_a630 , na.rm = T ))

merged_INS <-rbind(INS_reads_h453 %>% 
                     left_join(overlapped_INS_reads %>%
                                 filter(!is.na(ID_h453)) %>%
                                       dplyr::select(ID = ID_h453, commonID, commonend, commonSV_len)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
                           dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
        dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end = commonend, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod, SV_len= commonSV_len) %>%
          mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP H4-53"),
      INS_reads_a630 %>%
        inner_join(overlapped_INS_reads %>%
                      filter(!is.na(ID_a630))  %>%
                                       dplyr::select(ID = ID_a630, commonID, commonend, commonSV_len)) %>%
                           dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
                           dplyr::rename(ID = commonID)%>%
        dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end = commonend, read_id, read_type, forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod, SV_len =commonSV_len )%>%
          mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP A6-30"))%>%
  dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end, ref_position, read_id, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample, SV_len) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rbind(INS_reads_uwb1_brca1 %>%
          mutate(Sample = if_else(read_type == "parent", "UWB1", "UWB1 BRCA1"),
                 ID = paste0(ID, "_U")) %>%
          dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, read_id, SV_end, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample, SV_len)) %>%
  mutate(ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position -1, ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(ID, SV_start, SV_end, ref_position, chrom,  read_type, SV_len) %>%
  filter(n()>3) %>%
  summarise(Meth = sum(mod == "Me"), read_cnts = n(),
            Unmeth = read_cnts - Meth,
            meth_perc = Meth/read_cnts) %>%
  ungroup() 

plot_INS <- merged_INS %>%
  filter(read_type == "parent", (meth_perc >=0.8| meth_perc <= 0.2) ) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, p_meth_perc= meth_perc) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_INS%>%
              filter(read_type == "ref")) %>%
  filter(abs(meth_perc - p_meth_perc) <=0.2) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_INS %>%
              filter(read_type != "parent")) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position -SV_start,
                               ref_position >= SV_end ~ ref_position -SV_end,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  distinct()%>%
  group_by(SV_len, ID, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_type)==2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  arrange(SV_len, ID, ref_position, read_type)


CpG_INS_fisher <- plot_INS  %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, ref_position,chrom, read_type, Meth, Unmeth, SV_len) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = c(Meth, Unmeth),names_from = read_type)%>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(ID, ref_position, SV_len) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p.value =fisher.test(x = matrix(c(Meth_alt, Meth_ref, Unmeth_alt, Unmeth_ref),byrow = T, nrow = 2))$p.value ) %>%
  mutate(diff = Meth_alt/(Meth_alt+Unmeth_alt) -  Meth_ref/(Meth_ref+Unmeth_ref)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(fisher.adj = p.adjust(p.value,method = "BH"),
         sig = (fisher.adj <= 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.8 )) %>%
  ungroup()  


plot_INS_density <- plot_INS%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Meth, Unmeth, read_cnts)) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = meth_perc, names_from = read_type) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position -SV_start,
                               ref_position >= SV_end ~ ref_position -SV_end,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  mutate(diff = alt- ref) %>%
  distinct() 

plot_INS_density$density <-get_density(plot_INS_density$relat_pos, plot_INS_density$diff, n =40)

plot_INS_density%>%
  left_join(CpG_INS_fisher) %>%
  mutate(sig = factor(sig, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = relat_pos, y = diff, color = density, shape = sig))+
  geom_point(alpha= 0.8)+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_color_viridis_c( name = "density")+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("FALSE"= 4, "TRUE" = 19),  "Sig change")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, "ALT - REF (%5mC)")+
  xlab("Relative distance to breakpoint (bp)")+
  ggtitle("INS (SV)")+
  coord_cartesian(xlim= c(-5000, 5000))

ggsave("plots/INS_change.jpeg", width = 8, height = 4)


write.csv(plot_INS_density%>%
  left_join(CpG_INS_fisher) %>%
  mutate(sig = factor(sig, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))) %>%
     dplyr::select(chrom, ref_position, relat_pos, diff, density, fisher.adj),file = "output/tables_plotting/SuppFig17_INS_sv_density.csv",row.names = F, quote = F)
```

## Panel C

```{r}
indel_change_counts <- rbind(CpG_indel_ins_fisher %>%
         dplyr::rename(alt_len = indel_size) %>%
        mutate(type = "INDEL"),
      CpG_INS_fisher%>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = SV_len) %>%
        mutate(type = "SV")) %>%
  mutate(Group = "Deletion",
         Sample =case_when(str_detect(ID, "_U$") ~"UWB1 BRCA1",
                           str_detect(ID, "_a630$") ~"OVCAR8 LP A6-30",
                           str_detect(ID, "_h453$") ~"OVCAR8 LP H4-53",
                           str_detect(ID, "_common$") ~"OVCAR8 common"),
         Sample = factor(Sample),
         starting =case_when(Meth_ref/ (Meth_ref +Unmeth_ref) >= 0.8 ~ "Ref Methylated",
                             Meth_ref/ (Meth_ref +Unmeth_ref) <= 0.2 ~ "Ref Unmethylated",
                             TRUE ~NA),
         starting = factor(starting, levels = c("Ref Methylated", "Ref Unmethylated")))  %>%
  filter(!is.na(starting)) %>%
  group_by(ID, alt_len, Group, type, Sample, starting) %>%
  summarise(changed = case_when( max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) & min(diff) <= -0.8  ~ "Bi-Directional",
                                   max(diff) >= 0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Increase",
                                   min(diff) <= -0.8 & sum(sig) > 0 ~ "Decrease",
                                   TRUE ~ "No Change")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(type, Sample, changed, starting) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(changed = factor(changed, levels = c("Bi-Directional", "Increase", "Decrease", 
                                              "No Change")))  


indel_change_counts%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = type, fill = changed, y = count))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black")+
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("N= ", count)),
             position=  position_fill(vjust = 0.5))+
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Sample), rows = vars(starting))+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Insertion Type")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sig_change_palette, "CpG changed (N>=1)")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, "Event with methylation change")+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA))

ggsave("plots/breakdown_Insertion_type_dir.pdf", width = 10, height =4)

write.csv(indel_change_counts ,file = "output/tables_plotting/SuppFig17_INS_counts.csv",row.names = F, quote = F)
```

```{r}
          mutate(Sample = "OVCAR8 LP A6-30"))%>%
  dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, SV_end, ref_position, read_id, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample, SV_len) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rbind(DUP_reads_uwb1_brca1 %>%
          mutate(Sample = if_else(read_type == "parent", "UWB1", "UWB1 BRCA1"),
                 ID = paste0(ID, "_U")) %>%
          dplyr::select(ID, SV_start, read_id, SV_end, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, mod, read_type, Sample, SV_len)) %>%
  mutate(ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position -1, ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(ID, SV_start, SV_end, ref_position, chrom,  read_type, SV_len) %>%
  filter(n()>3) %>%
  summarise(Meth = sum(mod == "Me"), read_cnts = n(),
            Unmeth = read_cnts - Meth,
            meth_perc = Meth/read_cnts) %>%
  ungroup() 

plot_DUP <- merged_DUP %>%
  filter(read_type == "parent", (meth_perc >=0.8| meth_perc <= 0.2) ) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, p_meth_perc= meth_perc) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_DUP%>%
              filter(read_type == "ref")) %>%
  filter(abs(meth_perc - p_meth_perc) <=0.2) %>%
  dplyr::select(ref_position, chrom, ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(merged_DUP %>%
              filter(read_type != "parent")) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position -SV_start,
                                ref_position > SV_start &ref_position < SV_end ~ (ref_position-SV_start)/SV_len *5000,
                               ref_position >= SV_end ~ ref_position -SV_end +5000,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  distinct()%>%
  group_by(SV_len, ID, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_type)==2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  arrange(SV_len, ID, ref_position, read_type)


CpG_DUP_fisher <- plot_DUP  %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, ref_position,chrom, read_type, Meth, Unmeth, SV_len) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = c(Meth, Unmeth),names_from = read_type)%>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(ID, ref_position, SV_len) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p.value =fisher.test(x = matrix(c(Meth_alt, Meth_ref, Unmeth_alt, Unmeth_ref),byrow = T, nrow = 2))$p.value ) %>%
  mutate(diff = Meth_alt/(Meth_alt+Unmeth_alt) -  Meth_ref/(Meth_ref+Unmeth_ref)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(fisher.adj = p.adjust(p.value,method = "BH"),
         sig = (fisher.adj <= 0.05 & abs(diff) >= 0.8 )) %>%
  ungroup()  


plot_DUP_density <- plot_DUP%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Meth, Unmeth, read_cnts)) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = meth_perc, names_from = read_type) %>%
  mutate(relat_pos = case_when(ref_position <= SV_start ~ ref_position -SV_start,
                               ref_position > SV_start &ref_position < SV_end ~ (ref_position-SV_start)/SV_len *5000,
                               ref_position >= SV_end ~ ref_position -SV_end +5000,
                               TRUE ~NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relat_pos))%>%
  mutate(diff = alt- ref) %>%
  distinct() 


plot_DUP_density$density <-get_density(plot_DUP_density$relat_pos, plot_DUP_density$diff, n =80)

plot_DUP_density%>%
  inner_join(CpG_DUP_fisher) %>%
  mutate(sig = factor(sig, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = relat_pos, y = diff, color = density))+
  geom_point(alpha= 0.8,aes(shape = sig))+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_color_viridis_c( name = "density")+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("FALSE"= 4, "TRUE" = 19),  "Sig change")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, "ALT - REF (%5mC)")+
  xlab("Relative distance to breakpoint (bp)")+
  ggtitle("DUP (SV)")+
  coord_cartesian(xlim= c(-5000, 10000))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-5000, -2500, 0, 5000, 7500, 10000), labels = c("-5000", "-2500", "BP_1", "BP_2", "2500", "5000"))

ggsave("plots/DUP_change.jpeg", width = 8, height = 4,)


write.csv(plot_DUP_density%>%
  inner_join(CpG_DUP_fisher) %>%
  mutate(sig = factor(sig, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE")))  %>%
     dplyr::select(chrom, ref_position, relat_pos, diff, density, fisher.adj),file = "output/tables_plotting/SuppFig18_DUP_density.csv",row.names = F, quote = F)
```

```         
        The junction_type_data list contains the repair type category counts.  [0] TMEJ, del_size >= 4 and 
        microhomology_size >= 2; [1] NHEJ, del_size < 4 and ins_size < 5; [2] insertions >= 5 
        [3] Junctions with scars not represented by the other categories; [4] Non-MH Deletions, del_size >= 4 and 
        microhomology_size < 2 and ins_size < 5: [5] SNV, del_size > 1 and del_size == ins_size and 
        lft_del <= kmer_size and rt_del <= kmer_size
```

```{r}
          left_join(merged_indel_del %>%

  CpG_DEL_fisher %>%
        dplyr::rename(alt_len = SV_len) %>%

          left_join(merged_DEL %>%
                      dplyr::select(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end) %>%

          group_by(ID, chrom, SV_start, SV_end ,alt_len) %>%

#forward
five_prime_flank <- getSeq(hg38,  merged_DEL_simp$chrom, merged_DEL_simp$SV_start - 7, merged_DEL_simp$SV_start+8)
three_prime_flank <- getSeq(hg38, merged_DEL_simp$chrom, merged_DEL_simp$SV_end -7, merged_DEL_simp$SV_end + 8)
deleted_microhom <- cbind(merged_DEL_simp, tibble(five_prime_flank = as.character(five_prime_flank), 
                                three_prime_flank = as.character(three_prime_flank))) %>%
  mutate(Sample = case_when(str_detect(ID, "_U$") ~"UWB1 BRCA1",
                           TRUE ~ "OVCAR8"),
          Sample = factor(Sample)) %>%
  group_by(ID, Sample) 


get_match_matrix <- function(seqA, seqB, n) {
  basesA <- strsplit(seqA, "")[[1]]
  basesB <- rev(strsplit(seqB, "")[[1]])
  outer(basesA, basesB, Vectorize(function(a, b) as.integer(a == b)))
}



O_matrix_no <- deleted_microhom %>%
  filter(Sample == "OVCAR8", !changed) %>%
  group_map(~ get_match_matrix(.x$three_prime_flank, .x$five_prime_flank))  %>%
  Reduce('+', .)

O_matrix <- deleted_microhom %>%
  filter(Sample == "OVCAR8", changed) %>%
  mutate(n = n_distinct(ID)) %>%
  group_map(~ get_match_matrix(.x$three_prime_flank, .x$five_prime_flank))  %>%
  Reduce('+', .)
nochange_mat <- O_matrix_no/max(O_matrix_no)

colnames(nochange_mat) <- as.character(colnames(nochange_mat))

change_mat <- O_matrix/max(O_matrix)
rownames(change_mat) <-c(seq(-8,-1), seq(1,8))
colnames(change_mat) <-c(seq(-8,-1), seq(1,8))
rownames(change_mat) <- as.character(rownames(change_mat))
colnames(change_mat) <- as.character(colnames(change_mat))

pdf("plots/microhom_ov_sig_change.pdf")

dev.off()

pdf("plots/microhom_ov_insig_change.pdf")
ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(nochange_mat ,cluster_rows = F, cluster_columns = F,col = col_fun,  column_title = "Microhomolpgy around breakends without methylation change")
dev.off()


write.csv(change_mat ,file = "output/tables_plotting/SuppFig19_changed_cpg_del_ovcar8.csv",row.names = T, quote = F)
write.csv(nochange_mat ,file = "output/tables_plotting/SuppFig19_nochange_cpg_del_ovcar8.csv",row.names = T, quote = F)

five_prime_flank <- getSeq(hg38,  merged_DEL_simp$chrom, merged_DEL_simp$SV_start - 2, merged_DEL_simp$SV_start-1)
three_prime_flank <- getSeq(hg38, merged_DEL_simp$chrom, merged_DEL_simp$SV_end-2, merged_DEL_simp$SV_end-1 )

deleted_microhom <- cbind(merged_DEL_simp, tibble(five_prime_flank = as.character(five_prime_flank), 
                                three_prime_flank = as.character(three_prime_flank))) %>%
  mutate(Sample = case_when(str_detect(ID, "_U$") ~"UWB1 BRCA1",
                            # str_detect(ID, "_a630$") ~"OVCAR8 LP A6-30",
                            # str_detect(ID, "_h453$") ~"OVCAR8 LP H4-53",
                           TRUE ~ "OVCAR8"),
         twobase_microhomology = five_prime_flank== three_prime_flank,
          Sample = factor(Sample)) %>%
  group_by(ID, Sample) %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(twobase_microhomology &alt_len >=4 ~ "TMEJ (del >4bp, mh>=2bp)",
                          !twobase_microhomology &alt_len >=4 ~ "non-MH Deletion",
                          alt_len <4 ~ "NHEJ (del <4bp)"))


library(rstatix)
library(glue)
df <- deleted_microhom %>%
  filter(alt_len >= 4) %>%
  mutate(threebase = five_prime_flank == three_prime_flank)

chisq_res <- df %>%
  group_by(Sample, changed, type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  # reshape to a matrix (rows: changed, cols: type)
  summarise(test = list(chisq.test(
    xtabs(n ~ changed + type, data = cur_data_all())
  )), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(tidy = map(test, broom::tidy)) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(tidy) %>%
  select(Sample, statistic, parameter, p.value, method) %>%
  mutate(y = 106,label = glue("chi^2=={round(statistic, 2)}~~(p==\"{format.pval(p.value, digits = 2)}\")"),
    x = -Inf
  )


ggplot(df, aes(x = changed)) +
  geom_bar(color = "black", aes(fill = type)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Sample) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  geom_text(
    data = chisq_res ,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    hjust = -0.02, vjust = 0, parse = TRUE, size = 4
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 30, 10, 30))
ggsave("plots/repair_ways.pdf",height = 4, width = 7)

write.csv(df ,file = "output/tables_plotting/SuppFig19_repair_pathway.csv",row.names = F, quote = F)
```

```{r}
                               str_detect(sample, "guide1") ~"guide #1",
                               str_detect(sample, "guide2") ~"guide #2"),
         rep = case_when(str_detect(sample, "baseline") ~"Untreated",
                               str_detect(sample, "rep1") ~"rep1",
                               str_detect(sample, "rep2") ~"rep2",
                         str_detect(sample, "rep3") ~"rep3")) %>%
  filter(allele %in% c("CCCCCCCCC", "TTTTTTTTT"))



library(ggpubr)
amplicon  %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample_id)) %>%
  mutate(rep = factor(rep, levels = c("rep3",  "rep2", "rep1","Untreated" )),
         BRCA1_epiallele = if_else(allele =="CCCCCCCCC", "unmethylated", "methylated" )) %>%
  group_by(sample_id, rep) %>%
  mutate(percent = frequency / sum(frequency)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rep, y = percent, fill = BRCA1_epiallele))+
    geom_bar(position = "stack",stat = "identity")+
    facet_wrap(~sample_id)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("unmethylated"= "#3B6FB6", "methylated" = "#B63B3B")) +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent)+
  geom_text(aes(label= frequency), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5))+
  coord_flip()
  
ggsave("plots/amplicon_plots.pdf", height = 5, width = 13)

write.csv( amplicon  %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample_id)) %>%
  mutate(rep = factor(rep, levels = c("rep3",  "rep2", "rep1","Untreated" )),
         BRCA1_epiallele = if_else(allele =="CCCCCCCCC", "unmethylated", "methylated" )) %>%
  group_by(sample_id, rep) %>%
  mutate(percent = frequency / sum(frequency)) %>%
  ungroup(),file = "output/tables_plotting/SuppFig21_crispr_guide_post_selection.csv",row.names = F, quote = F)
```

```{r}
cisplatin <-  Sys.glob("data/incucytes/*rep1_2_cisplatin*.csv") %>%
  map_dfr(~fread(.x, skip = 3) %>%
  mutate(rowL = str_sub(Well, 1,1),
         colL = str_sub(Well, 2,3)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(V1, Well)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "colL", values_from = "Lum") %>%
  dplyr::select(-c("1", "12")) %>%
  filter(!rowL %in% c("A", "H") ) %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("rowL","0", "5", "2.5" , "1.25", "0.5", "0.25", "0.125", "0.05", "0.025", "0.0125")) %>%
    mutate(sample = sub(".*/(.*?)_rep.*", "\\1", .x),
           rep = c( rep("rep1", 3,),rep("rep2", 3)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c("rowL", "sample", "rep"), values_to = "Lum", names_to = "Conc") %>%
  mutate(drug = "cisplatin")

files <- Sys.glob("data/incucytes/*rep1_2_olaparib*.csv")
olaparib <-  map_dfr(files, function(f){
  df <- fread(f, skip = 3) %>%
    mutate(
      rowL = str_sub(Well, 1, 1),
      colL = str_sub(Well, 2, 3)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(V1, Well)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = colL, values_from = Lum) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c("1", "12")) %>%
    filter(!rowL %in% c("A", "H"))
  if (grepl("guide1", f)) {
    colnames(df) <- c("rowL", "5", "2.5" , "0.5", "0.25", "0.05", "0.025", "0.005", "0.0025", "0.0005","0")
  } else {
    colnames(df) <- c("rowL","0", "5", "2.5" , "0.5", "0.25", "0.05", "0.025", "0.005", "0.0025", "0.0005")
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      sample = sub(".*/(.*?)_rep.*", "\\1", f),
      rep = rep(c("rep1", "rep2"), each = nrow(df)/2),
      drug = "olaparib"
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -c("rowL", "sample", "rep", "drug"), values_to = "Lum", names_to = "Conc")
})
```

```{r}

library(drc)
ctg_surv$sample <- as.factor(ctg_surv$sample)

cisplatin_ctg <- ctg_surv%>%
  filter(drug == "cisplatin")

cis_model <- drc::drm(survival_perc ~ Conc, curveid = sample,  data = cisplatin_ctg, fct = LL.4(),
             control = drmc(errorm = FALSE))
compParm(cis_model, "e", operator = "-")

IC50_cis <- ED(cis_model, 50, interval = "delta")

olaparib_ctg <- ctg_surv%>%
  filter(drug == "olaparib")

ola_model <- drc::drm(survival_perc ~ Conc, curveid = sample,  data =  fct = LL.4(),
             control = drmc(errorm = FALSE))
compParm(ola_model, "e", operator = "-")

library(emmeans)

model_lm <- lm(survival_perc ~ sample * Conc, data = olaparib_ctg%>%
                 filter(Conc >1))

emm <- emmeans(model_lm, pairwise ~ sample | Conc)
pvals <- summary(emm$contrasts)


pvals$signif <- cut(pvals$p.value,
                   breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
                   labels = c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))
```

```{r}
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample_Group,
    values_from = Sample.ID,
    values_fn = \(x) paste(x, collapse = "; ")
  )

sum(!is.na(counts$Relapse))
```

```{r}
drug_ctg %>% 
  group_by(sample,  drug, Conc) %>%
  summarise(mean_lum = mean(Lum), sd_lum = sd(Lum), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels= c("parental", "guide1", "guide2")),
         drug = factor(drug, levels = c("olaparib", "cisplatin"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Conc, y = mean_lum,
             colour = sample,
             group = sample)) +
  scale_x_log10("Concentration (uM)") +
  ylab("Luminescence")+
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~drug, nrow = 2)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_lum - sd_lum,
                  ymax = mean_lum + sd_lum),
              width = 0.1)+
  scale_colour_manual(values = sample_pal)

ggsave("plots/ctg_lum_olaparib_selection.pdf", height = 7, width = 6)
```
